Live sheet artifacts (`artifact_create(kind:"sheet")`, `/@cawco/sheet`, slice 1 landed in d9ede1e03/495066138) only work with Vite 6 or newer. A project on Vite 5 is refused by name, with a clear message instead of silently breaking.

Supporting Vite 5 would need a second code path in the sheet toolchain. I haven't built that, because it needs your go-ahead.

Your options are to keep the Vite ≥6 only rule and the by-name refusal, or to approve a second code path for Vite 5. My memory doesn't record a recommendation from me or any preference from you, so I'm not picking one.
